breakdown.description: It asks for the subsurface carbon content to reach 1.10 wt% C even though the surface is held at only 0.90 wt% C. A concentration inside the solid cannot exceed the imposed constant surface concentration in this setup.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the physically impossible instruction to have a subsurface carbon concentration (1.10 wt% C) higher than the surface concentration (0.90 wt% C). The ground truth correctly changes this value to a plausible 0.60 wt% C.
